ios.desc:
Routines is a checklist app for the repeated tasks and chores in your life. Use Routines to keep recurring tasks from cluttering your calendar, email, and other to-do lists.

With built-in daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly checklists, Routines makes it easy to stay on track and provides reminders for the important to-dos in your life.

• Overwhelmed by routine housework? Use Routines to track chores and never miss a thing again.
• Want to build good habits? Use Routines to keep “doing it” until it becomes second nature.
• Learning a new skill? Use Routines to set up a recurring schedule for practice.
• Keep missing your monthly report deadline? Use Routines to remind you of important tasks ahead of time.

Keep recurring tasks separate from your main to-do list and calendar with Routines. Download Routines and see how this approach can help you stay focused and improve productivity.

OUR USERS SAY
“We use Routines at work to standardize the day. This app is exactly what I needed to stick to my routine and remain accountable for my work. Love it.”

“The perfect app for creating a routine for home, work—anything! Don’t waste money on other apps!”

FEATURES

* Add recurring tasks to daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly checklists to keep routine tasks separate from your calendar and other to-do lists.
* The Home tab provides a dashboard view of all tasks happening today across your daily/weekly/monthly/yearly lists.
* In each list, tap the title to switch between different views with alternative groupings and sorting.
* Add context to tasks. Create your own contexts (for example, Home and Work) and assign one context to each task.
* Use tags to describe tasks with keywords or labels. Assign one or more tags to each task and create as many tags as you need.
* Tap the filter bar to filter lists by context and/or tags.
* Create alerts to receive notifications before or on a task’s due date. Routines uses local notifications so reminders work even when you’re offline.
* Turn on Auto-Highlight to colour task titles in orange for tasks due within a range you set in Settings—an at-a-glance reminder of what’s coming up.
* Turn on Auto-Uncheck to automatically uncheck tasks at a specified time. For example, reset weekly tasks every Monday at 1:00 am for a clean slate.

Routines is a universal app for iPhone and iPad. No sign-up required. No ads. All data stays on your device.
